title: Member Services Training Note — Reinstating a Lapsed Premium Billing Account
content:
**Q. Which Premium Billing Accounts can be reinstated, and until when?**
A lapsed account may be reinstated only no later than the reinstatement window after the lapse termination date recorded as its paid-through date. The window is the arrangement's reinstatement window in calendar days, counted from the paid-through date, and a reinstatement on the last day of the window is in time. An arrangement whose window is 0 cannot be reinstated. The dates come from the account's recorded paid-through date in the company's system, as it stands before the reinstatement.

**Q. What must be paid?**
Reinstatement requires payment of all premium past due through the current month, by a method in the arrangement's reinstatement payment methods. The premium past due is the net premium due for the coverage months from the month after the paid-through date through the current month, less payments and credits applied to them.

**Q. Can an account be reinstated again and again?**
No. Reinstatement is refused when the account's reinstatements already counted in the rolling 12 months ending on the reinstatement date — reinstatement payments that have not been returned — have reached the arrangement's reinstatement allowance.

**Q. What does reinstatement do?**
The account returns to active, the funded enrollments that ended for nonpayment are reinstated without a gap, and claims denied as not eligible in the gap are reprocessed.

**Q. And if the window passes?**
When the window ends without reinstatement the account closes, and any credit balance is refunded under the credit rules.

**Boundary case (hypothetical 30-day window).** The paid-through date is 30 April. 30 April plus 30 calendar days is 30 May.
| Reinstatement date | In time? |
|---|---|
| 30 May (last day of the window) | yes |
| 31 May | no |

**Case (hypothetical).** An individual account with an allowance of 1 already has one unreturned reinstatement payment eleven months ago: a second reinstatement now is refused, even inside the window.
